units.function: Filesystem/process tests for Gemini-local environment diagnostics: cwd creation, CLI hello-probe flags/env, quota classification and remote sandbox trust propagation.
units.dependencyDirection: Vitest -> Gemini-local testEnvironment -> real temporary local command or fake remote runner; no Company OS-style SecretPort, runtime attestation, real Gemini network/API or database is involved.
units.keyDataModels: Adapter type/config engine/command/cwd/model/yolo/env, local or remote sandbox execution target, environment name and structured diagnostic status/check code.
units.lifecycle: Validate/create cwd -> resolve and launch CLI probe with config/env -> parse result or quota stderr -> report checks; remote target delegates execution and marks workspace trusted.
units.testAssessment: Focused Vitest passed 4/4 with fake commands/runner and no real credentials. The cases verify current side effects and propagation, not containment, credential safety, command provenance, ACP default behavior or trustworthy remote execution.
units.designRationale: Make setup diagnostics actionable by repairing a missing cwd, exercising the actual model/approval flags, distinguishing quota from generic failure and bypassing an interactive trust prompt inside a provisioned remote sandbox.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs Connector health and capability evidence that is safe, secret-minimized, deployment-neutral and does not itself perform privileged Agent/model work or mutate arbitrary customer paths.
units.companyOsFit: REIMPLEMENT as layered Connector diagnostics executed at the customer execution node: static config/schema, signed binary/version, credential-presence without disclosure, sandbox capability and an explicitly consented optional provider probe. Diagnostics must be non-mutating by default, command/image allowlisted, time/egress/tool bounded and return short-lived secret-free attestation codes.
units.responsibilityConflict: A diagnostic can create directories and launch a yolo model process without an approved Work/Action/Data contract or accountable human. Trusting a remote workspace through an env flag is not evidence that organizational responsibility or sandbox guarantees have been satisfied.
units.securityFindings: CRITICAL diagnostic privilege: the probe can execute an arbitrary PATH-resolved command with --approval-mode yolo and inherited credentials. HIGH host-filesystem mutation: a configured absolute cwd is created without tested containment. HIGH Secret boundary gap: API key lives in config.env and subprocess/log/persistence safety is unproven. HIGH remote-trust gap: GEMINI_CLI_TRUST_WORKSPACE bypass is asserted without runtime attestation. HIGH supply-chain gap: binary identity/version/signature is untested. MEDIUM error brittleness: quota classification depends on vendor stderr.
